outline.rationale: The user is in evaluation mode (deciding fit), an SWE with strong technical fundamentals, whose self-identified gap is product/user/business thinking. So I skip all tech explanation, coding, resume/portfolio, and interview tactics. Node 1 grounds them in what the role really is (essential for a fit decision). Node 2 clarifies how AIPM differs from adjacent roles they know, distinguishing AI-specific quirks. Nodes 3-6 directly target the confirmed gap: user problem discovery, prioritization under AI uncertainty, success metrics (with the AI-specific model-vs-product distinction they'd care about as an SWE), and business value—these map cleanly to the four themes in the understanding and are MECE. Node 7 leverages their SWE background specifically (transfer/unlearn), which is unique to their transition. Node 8 closes the loop on their actual goal: judging fit. No intro/conclusion filler; ordering runs from role understanding → core skills → self-assessment.
